steps.content: [Background - Research Institute Dungeon]
As Saffar steps back into the research institute, the first thing to greet him is an off-key, lilting voice.

Not far away, the cocoon continues its metamorphosis. The entity inside grows more distinct by the moment, its heartbeat swelling louder. Yet the prisoner bound beneath it remains utterly unfazed, almost relaxed.
Hypatia

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Oh...? Well, if it isn't little Saffar! These chains are practically strangling me. Be a dear and loosen them—

Synex shifts, but the chains—emerging like roots from the chamber's depths—wrench her back into place. Where the restraints bite into her flesh, cracks spiderweb across her skin, oozing a viscous fluid with a metallic gleam.

steps.speaker: Saffar
steps.content: You're dying.
Without another word, Saffar lifts his hand and rolls up his sleeve. The same Aurum Secretum corruption writhes on his skin, its luminous patterns mirroring hers.

steps.speaker: Saffar
steps.content: Aurum Secretum Warriors require regular doses to stabilize their Mania. Without it, their bodies break down at an accelerated rate. Right now, your system can't handle a full-scale insurrection. If you don't take Aurum Secretum soon, you won't survive.

steps.speaker: Saffar
steps.content: ...That reckless girl from DisCity is no different. She could've just run.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Heh... What's this? Feeling a little sympathy for her?
The young man doesn't answer, his face a mask of frost.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Oh, don't give me that look. Here I was, thinking we could have a nice little reunion... but I suppose you're not the sentimental type. So... let's just cut to the fun part.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Saffar, how about we burn it all down together?

steps.speaker: Saffar
steps.content: ...What?

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Did you really think Hypercubes would be priority one after the Black Ring explodes? Fraser's first move will be marching straight for DisCity's throat. And guess who gets to be the glorious frontline sacrifices? That's right... us. Either we get fed to the Black Ring, or we get chewed up in their little war.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: You don't want to die for nothing either, do you? So here's my offer: We blow up Fraser and the institute, and lead everyone to freedom—
Clang— Saffar's blade scrapes past Synex's shackles and bites into her throat. A thin crimson line blooms in its wake.
His hand does not waver—unnaturally steady, poised to carve deeper with the slightest shift.

steps.speaker: Saffar
steps.content: ...You still don't get it.

steps.speaker: Saffar
steps.content: You're the strongest Aurum Secretum Warrior we have. When others collapse under the weight of the world, you crush it under your feet and keep going. That's why you can't see it.

steps.speaker: Saffar
steps.content: What we've needed all along isn't freedom... It's the power to rewrite fate—a <color=#fb9259>hero</color>.
The Aurum Secretum shackles clink as Synex tilts her head, her laughter spilling forth, barely restrained.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: HAHAHAHA... No way... You're actually serious?

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: I thought only brainwashed lab rats who've never smelled real air could swallow Fraser's "hero" fairytales!

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Let's be real, what "hero" gets bred in a cage? Fattened for slaughter, then scolded for not saying "thank you" when the knife comes down? If you want to play that kind of hero, be my guest!

steps.speaker: Saffar
steps.content: Do you think I don't want to be one?!
Saffar raises his hand and yanks back his sleeve. His wrist is a ruin, barely held together by threads of flowing Aurum Secretum.

steps.speaker: Saffar
steps.content: Just one resonance nearly tore me apart... Same with that DisCity girl. Yeah, I feel sorry for her! But what else can I do?!

steps.speaker: Saffar
steps.content: The weak can only survive like this! None of us chose this!
He drags in a breath as if the air could steady the storm inside.

steps.speaker: Saffar
steps.content: Among all the test subjects... you're the only one who made it through every experiment. The only one who earned that pass. The only one who can... trigger the Black Ring, open new mines, and actually change things here.

steps.speaker: Saffar
steps.content: So...
He swiftly sheathes his sword.

steps.speaker: Saffar
steps.content: I beg you, don't throw away all those lives. Don't crush our last chance.
With those words, Saffar turns and walks away. A scornful laugh rings out behind him.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Coward.
He halts mid-step, spine rigid, but does not look back.

steps.speaker: Saffar
steps.content: ...I'm sorry.
Then he is gone. Once more, the room holds only Synex and the weight of her chains.
The shackles bite into her flesh, unyielding. Mania seethes beneath her skin, a wildfire scorching through bone and marrow.
Yet even as the agony consumes her, her lips twist into a grin. Then, laughter tears free, raw and ravenous.
[Cut to Flashback]
Death has no meaning. In this test facility, everyone dies eventually; it's only a matter of when. And only the survivors get to decide what "meaning" even is.

Once, in her agony, she looked up—high above, researchers in white coats would dispassionately observe the test subjects, watching them succumb to Mania, only uttering brief exclamations or sighs when someone either awakened or deteriorated.
Lives twisted, withered, and were reduced to scribbled notes in their records—worthless.

steps.speaker: Director Hermis
steps.content: Test Subject 819, <color=#fb9259>Synex</color>. You are our most exceptional specimen. It's time for you to serve our city and fulfill your purpose.
"Serve"? By giving her life away? For those who never see her as human?

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: You're dying. How unfortunate... Your end could have been so much more meaningful. But I can offer you a way out.
All those noble words from on high, yet in the end, they still chose to use her as a sacrifice.

steps.speaker: Saffar
steps.content: The weak can only survive like this! None of us chose this!

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: No... As long as one breathes, there are always choices.
She won't die here. Not like this. No matter how desperate, how ugly her struggle becomes, she will survive.
[Flashback: WhiteSands Background]
The merchant lay collapsed on the ground, his body already growing cold. She spotted the hidden envelop but left it untouched, letting the Legion find it when they arrived.
[Flashback: Furor]

Another mission complete. The enemy had fallen with resentment, their grip still clenched around an unnaturally sharp dagger. The blade hummed with whispers, a faint aura of madness clinging to its edge. Intrigued, she kept the blade for herself, never turning it in.
[Flashback: Maze Background]
She wasn't the only suitable Corpus vessel. Escaping outright had crossed her mind, but that would've been too dull. Too ordinary. What she wanted was to tear it all down.
When the girl and her companion stopped her outside the city, the gears had finally begun to turn. At last, the wildcard she'd been waiting for arrived.
[Back to Reality, Restraints CG]

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Heheh... The prey and the hunters are all in place. This farce is just one step from its climax. Wouldn't it be such a shame to die before the grand finale?

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: This life of mine... Oh, I've got much better plans for it...
